label: Family Memories
description: Instant photos, washi tape and handwritten notes on warm cardstock.

els.text: The people, the places and the ordinary days that made us who we are.
We packed too many sandwiches and stayed until the sun went down. Noah found three frogs.
She taught us her secret apple pie recipe.

Every Sunday the whole family squeezes around the kitchen table. Someone always burns the first pancake, Skippy waits for crumbs, and Noah tells the same joke again. These are the days we want to remember.

label: Happy Birthday
description: Confetti, balloons and bold, bright colours for the big day.

els.text: Balloons at dawn, presents by breakfast and a whole day of celebrating.
Candles, cake and so much laughter
Chocolate on the inside, sprinkles on the outside and frosting on everybody’s nose.
Seven is the best age ever!
Seven candles, one big breath and a cake shaped like a dinosaur. The party games went on until everyone was out of breath, and the best present was having all our friends in one room.

label: Wedding & Anniversary
description: Soft blush, gold details and elegant script.

els.text: Surrounded by family and friends, on the most beautiful day of the year.
I promise to always make your coffee.
We said our vows under the old oak tree, with everyone we love sitting in the sunshine. The music played, the cake was perfect and we danced until our feet hurt.
Our song came on and for three minutes there was nobody else in the room.

label: Holiday Season
description: Cosy plaid, twinkling lights and seasonal cheer.

els.text: Our favourite time of year, when everyone comes home.
The house smelled of cinnamon for a week. We hung the lights, made paper snowflakes for every window and stayed up late telling stories by the fire.
The first snow of the year: two snowmen, one snow dog and a lot of hot chocolate afterwards.

label: Vacation Adventures
description: Watercolour skies, film-strip frames and travel stickers.

els.text: Bags packed, snacks ready and a long road ahead.
Cobbled streets, a hundred steps up to the castle and the best pizza we have ever eaten.
We saw dolphins from the boat!
Ten days by the sea. We swam every morning, ate ice cream every afternoon and watched the sunset from the pier every evening. Nobody wanted to go home.

label: Growing Up
description: Bright primary colours, building blocks and crayon doodles.

els.text: The day our family got a little bit bigger and a lot more fun.
New shoes, a big backpack and only a few tears (from Mum).
First wobbly steps, first words, first day of school. Every year brings something new: a missing tooth, a new favourite book and a hundred more questions about everything.

label: Our Pets
description: Paw prints, scalloped frames and playful colours.

els.text: The day we met our new best friend.
Every puddle, every squirrel and every single stick in the park.
Skippy came home in a cardboard box and has been in charge ever since. He knows exactly when dinner is, which visitor has treats and how to take up the whole sofa.

label: Life Story
description: Timeless typography on linen, with room for the story.

els.text: She grew up on a farm at the edge of town, the youngest of five. She left home at eighteen to train as a nurse, met the love of her life at a dance and raised a family full of music and laughter.
A house full of brothers and sisters, chores before school and summers by the river.
Forty years of road trips, campsites and postcards from everywhere.
